claims.claim: AIOS deterministically grants non-interactive native mutation capability to mutation-authorizing PRIMARY, CODE_FIX REMEDIATION, and CODE_FIX REPAIR executions before invoking the selected Executor, while read-only execution receives a read-only native profile.
Capability selection remains inside the existing native execution boundary and preserves exactly one selected Executor invocation without retry, reroute, fallback, or an additional model invocation.
Existing Runtime HEAD, clean-worktree, committed-delta, scope, verification, review, remediation, repair, failure, transport, and publication gates remain authoritative.
Antigravity now returns its structural ResultPackage through native process output; Runtime captures and persists staging and canonical operational state without requiring Executor-side persistence.
